android.extraProguardRules:
# --- react-native-webview: WebView JavaScript bridge -----------------------
# Android's WebView calls @JavascriptInterface-annotated methods by name via
# reflection from injected JS (window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage). Without
# this rule R8 strips/renames those methods and postMessage/onMessage stop
# working, but only in release builds -- a widely reported issue for this
# library (react-native-webview/react-native-webview #975, #754, #1014, #2292).
-keepclassmembers class * {
  @android.webkit.JavascriptInterface *;
}

# --- react-native-screens: native Fragment-backed navigation ---------------
# Ships no proguard-rules.pro of its own. Android's FragmentManager
# instantiates Screen fragments by class name during state restoration (e.g.
# after a config change or process death); if R8 renames or strips these
# classes, this throws "Unable to instantiate fragment
# com.swmansion.rnscreens.ScreenFragment" -- a crash, not a silent failure
# (software-mansion/react-native-screens #1644, #2394, #3317).
-keep class com.swmansion.rnscreens.** { *; }

# --- react-native-gesture-handler -------------------------------------------
# Also ships no proguard-rules.pro. Kept broadly as a defensive measure,
# consistent with how its sibling libraries from the same maintainer
# (react-native-reanimated, react-native-worklets) already protect their own
# packages this way in their own shipped consumer rules.
-keep class com.swmansion.gesturehandler.** { *; }

# --- @react-native-async-storage/async-storage ------------------------------
# This app's entire data layer (recipients, messages, profile, theme,
# background settings, backup index -- see utils/storage.ts) goes through
# AsyncStorage. It ships no proguard-rules.pro and has multiple reported
# R8-related release-build failures (react-native-async-storage/async-storage
# #43, #718, #889). Highest-priority rule in this file: if this breaks, the
# whole app's persistence layer breaks.
-keep class com.reactnativecommunity.asyncstorage.** { *; }

# --- whisper.rn: native transcription bridge --------------------------------
# whisper.rn's own README asks for this rule directly when minification is
# enabled: its JNI bridge classes (com.rnwhisper.*) are looked up by name from
# native code, and R8 renaming/stripping them under minification breaks model
# loading and transcribe() calls in release builds -- on-device transcription
# would silently stop working.
-keep class com.rnwhisper.** { *; }
